|-|Trivia=
*The name, icon and requirement for '''There Was Room For Two''' are a reference to the much-debated scene in James Cameron's 1997 film {{W|Titanic (1997 film)|''Titanic''}}, in which the protagonist Jack refuses to climb aboard the wooden plank Rose was lying on over the fears that their combined weight will cause it to sink, which has since been debunked.
**Despite what's stated in the requirement, the policemen in question are not SWAT members, and use the model of regular kevlar-vested DCPD officers instead.
**The cops are internally named Kate and Leo, as a reference to actors {{W|Kate Winslet}} and {{W|Leonardo DiCaprio}}, who played Rose and Jack in the movie, respectively.
**The debug message for this achievement reads "GOT TITANIC ACHIEVEMENT".
